notes.title: Mining Update (0.11.1)
notes.notes:
Greetings captains!


9 months in, the update is ready!
Try it in the playtest or demo!

Gameplay has been greatly changed putting more emphasys on mining, ship building and progression all togheter.



	New asteroids

Each one holding hundreds of ore veins, enough to renovate your entire fleet.
Hide inside their craters but check for worms first!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/8d5cb4f2f57b00be445b0be2709e6f7854b83072.png

	New progression system

Getting drone cruisers and titanium in the starting sector but spending exactly 0 seconds in intermediary sectors until the center?
No more!, each sector has it's own ores and wave composition.
Now you will get to experience going through each upgrade tier rather than skipping half and never getting the last 2.
Other things like loot and player weapons have been chained for a progression oriented gameplay.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/4e5a36fb9345e215d391c5a2a7d850f2c22f552d.png

	New cockpit

Annoyed to have to go to 4 consoles in the middle of combat? 
The new cockpit has all the controls available for your starship at your fingers.
300 buttons, countless texts and indicators comparable in complexity to real planes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/ed46aea10439bc58d189bcbfd2eb8919de6edd27.png

	Breach based hull integrity

No more ship HP!, now damage consists of repairable breaches The Expanse style.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/d5c8a7bbcf5b3d01c03fc6c3ee39d065b62b1537.png

	New battleship drone

If you though cruisers are hard then prepare for hell. 
Featuring colossal weapons and more loot than several planet bases combined they are the ultimate boss.	

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/f1533008db5a3dc2db82af66bef0ae134f9f33c6.png

	Improved docking

Steal ships by docking and boosting, brand new docking UI that's way easier to use and the ability to take docked ships to other sectors via mfm.
Catching up to a ship that's drifting at 10km/s, docking then bringing it to a station is a lot more fun that I expected.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/a95ea8a973032cc3e9a2f2620deed0fbe9b4eb14.png

	Boss waves

Normal waves to easy for you? Here's the +50% difficulty increase for last wave that nobody asked for and nobody wants.

	New space survival scenarios

Start with a wrecked ship and no stations around. A true space survival experience.
Say goodbye to the campaign since nobody knew(no even me) what it was supposed to be.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/d330a0511b3189a08fd2fec579ec944331574675.png

	PVP mode

You want it, I want it so let's get down to business and hunt each other down.
Still experimental, especially with Unity's limits on physics.

	Easier inter-deck building

Annoyed that you can repair or dismantle blocks only in the same deck? no more! 
You might need to place down flooring for decks for pre-existing ship designs.

	Improved automatons

2 new upgrade tiers for the old automaton with the ability to fix breaches and refill bottles on top of moving faster and having more hp.
They can coordinate to not take the same task and to go for the closest block.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/4cc823a03896f3b46648665988554f98ca323429.png

	Battle bridge

When the top saucer section bridge(I mean.... the navigation bridge) is too exposed for combat where do you go?
The new battle bridge offers 1m thick steel armor and is pressurized so you can breath fresh air when the ship hull is breached out of existence.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/92235f81307eae34cbe630a8cd7225b3e2bf5de7.png

	New artifacts

Can't decide what do do with the 4 gargoholds of extra alien artifacts? No more!
Introducing 4 new relics that have specific uses and are needed to get end game gear including the top level automatons!
Spacial fold relic, Star cradle relic, Soul trap relic, Reverberating core relic, each representing destruction, heat, automation and ftl. You can even grow them out of each other!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/7bfd2837d56ce92ba9acb132c41189106148c8fd.png

	Teleporter mod

Beam me up Scoty!
Teleport at the door of the wreck directly!, no more jetpacking. One click to pay a visit to traders at the station.
To keep Adro realistic the teleporter is packaged as a mod.
It even comes with a beam-back remote!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/2214e9aba8b7a4f45de214aeaa2734fca1ce2cc6.gif

	Vaulting

Who needs stairs anyway?

	Fly By Wire

How did Adro make it as a space sim for so many years without it?

	Pick up blocks

Tired of dismantling, recrafting and building again to redesign your ship? now just pickup and place with any tool.

	Weekly update notes panel

	Not a fan of discord but want to keep up with the development? Open the game from time to time and an in-game panel will appear with all the weekly development notes from my finger tips directly to your retina. Factorio friday facts Adrorium style. 

	Countless bugfixes & changes

I said countless? I mean I counted them, each one, 148 in total.

	Countless QoL features

These I really didn't count but there must be at least 30, including delta v calculations, more detailed ship ui indicators, faster start up time, sorted ship inventory, simplified recipes, +100% and +50% tool speed buffs on high morale, faster shields recharge time and many many more.

	Instructions block

With 15 visual guides on key aspects of Adro. Each ship comes equipped with one. No more 'Ma ship no workin, beholder, what do?'.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/ee938b61cfe2450b71e6cb3f42bbe2a6b90f26de.png

	Few more blocks

Like the fluid dispenser or text signs plus built in mods to get access to more previously uncraftable blocks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/6099005738e6806c022b882b59ec682ed47aef99.png

	Day 0 android port

So you can play right now with your weird cousin that somehow doesn't have a pc in 2025.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/d62834cee2fdfa279dd3fa358e75a60e81877181.png

	Run by default

Pinky finger hurts from holding shift non stop? Now you will never have to touch it again(shift, not the finger) and once you get used to it, you will never walk again #alwaysrunning. Running in Adro is not a viable substitute for running in real life.

	Bloom & Ambient occlusion

I don't care about graphics. 'Messes with bloom.' I didn't care about graphics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/fc19200a63a942b59dcbe5e488eba757cd06b258.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/924ba29d69eda70e85c7b8ec0608a358e88bcf17.png

	Updated tutorial

With indicators for buttons, simpler steps and no more softlocks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/f535d301ea8b06100da956e5671689e64f4d1d0f.png


Full changelog

	
Did you catch all the references?




Signing out,
Beholder

notes.title: Colossal Update (0.11.0)
notes.notes:
Greetings captains!


This update is ready, now!
You can play it through the demo or beta playtest.

One of the largest updates so far that completely changes progression and the way you build your ship.


	Automaton

Your own personal handyman capable of repairing, rebuilding and farming. It is yet unknown what powers its internal systems.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/266cd4e21cbab69a5e53383a44deea98cddfd9b1.png

	PDA designer

Tired of blindly building your ship? now you can see and plan out the design directly from the pda.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/bbe0eba0aff826b692e730083923a41abdf41237.png


	New progression system & 5 new metals

With the new tiered blocks you have to make several stops along the way to pick up increasingly more valuable resources to build those new colossal hardware. Progression is locked behind 5 new materials that are found the deeper you go into the galaxy: 


 Steel
 Duralumin
 Cobinel
 Bio-Molecular Iron
 Bio-Molecular titanium



	Asteroids everywhere

Do you even need an explanation for this? Mining has finally became a profitable time investment, especially with asteroids made out of gold that fill the central sectors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/2d990399981cb9e4f80949ecbd16d41bc54f9d15.png


	9 new gatlings

With 400x more power than the tier 1, the new colossal variants will shred any drone in seconds. Finally a good alternative to railguns.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/78960c6175fbf7250ef70b01a35ba4dfe7cd3162.png

	9 new rocket launchers

Annoyed by the barrage of missiles drones throw at you? Now you can annoy them as well, without the worry that the launchers will get destroyed. Not sure why they still attack when they see a rocket launcher that is bigger than your ship....

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/3774092960558de280d08094333cc7d6bbe1ba37.png

	9 new boosters

Annoyed by the bed of boosters you had to build/repair on your ship? One Colossal booster is more than enough to propel you to the other side of the universe.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/270a87ae029e77a845fd4308c2bcf26bfb19e3c9.png

	9 new rcs blocks

Disappointed you can't get the ship to spin at 120 rpm fast enough to annoy your crewmates? Now you can. Please don't.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/1dbb94510c32bca272460b8c80d28b864d908461.png

	45 new tank blocks

To fuel your new colossal boosters and rcs. New fluid: Xenon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/4a084a90a245f3bc42fbb1d1caba6bab641df3b2.png



	Inventory fetching V2 (MP)

Annoyed your crew keeps that cargobox locked all the time? Now you have access to the contents of the box for crafting, fetching, upgrading and farming in multiplayer without having to interact with it.


	New main ship: Canigva

Major version comes with a major redesign. Now with scalable tank positions, nicer room layout and a single airlock.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/6e367a90adb6cd5d0e0b15f7a1ce6392e24da081.png


	More modding options

Add your own turrets, boosters, npcs and basically any already defined block, no restrictions. Turrets can consume from a secondary grid and several new options.


	Rewrite for most of the code

As with any 0.x version, a lot of the code was rewritten, especially the pda, asset managing, ship firing and input.


	Crafting areas

Access all crafters directly from your own inventory. No more back and forth to each one for intermediate ingredients. *Convenience*

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/28d42400214ba91eeb542dad65599a8f2064a18e.png


	Orbit mechanics

Always wanted your ship to freefal into the planet without worrying that it will crash? now you get the ui to help you do that. Gotta rush celestial navigation now that ksp2 is dead.


	Automated ship firing

For truly afk space battles.


	Simplified many recipes

Because I know how much you hate spending time figuring out intermediate ingredients.


	4 times bigger planets

Now that you have overpowered colossal boosters you need a new challenge to compensate: escape the colossal planet.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/aad16c678d0945e1ff02efd61991d5ceddeb852d.png

notes.title: Convenience Update (0.10.5)
notes.notes:
Hi captains!


This update is out, now!
You can play it yourself through the playtest option or through the demo. 

The update consists of a multitude of features designed to improve the quality of the game:


	Planet survival scenarios

Sick of always starting in space with a fully functional ship? Survive and eventually repair a wrecked ship to escape the harsh environment in the new planet survival scenarios.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/5ff1c662853a9704458f166fd59c7b0dbf523be3.png

	Inventory fetching

Inventory management is the final boss in most games and it's not fun. I know. Now you can fetch/pull inventory directly from the ship for crafting, planting and repairing. Quick send to ship also included.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/137784a47633c27ceebb1ae7cd7a3d26c488169f.png


	Reliable multiplayer connection

Developed a brand new reliable network module for multiplayer to ensure packets are going to reliably arrive to your peers. Say goodbye to de-syncs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/28ecff221cd2e0ec7c9f2127349c7b8cead20f14.png


	4 new pois and drones

With 2 more drone variants and 2 more planet base designs the game will no longer feel so similar in your away missions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/8d5a5568319a2ae04f9f09b7394493f8547b6bb3.png


	Adjacent upgrade

Who has time to dismantle the smaller blocks in order to build a larger one? Not me, just place 4 tanks of same type together and a new mega tank will take their place. 2 mega tanks make a colossal one, more than enough to fuel your booster bed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/dc97d4ab479508cacf7f25a296817a34ac3018f6.gif


	New blocks and new items


Beacon
Want to score a new record but don't have time to wait for the waves to come? The beacon will broadcast your location making them come 4 times faster.
Semiconductor Fabricator
Running low on CPUs and ICs, craft them yourself, no engineering knowledge required. Be careful!, this block is very expensive to build.
New tanks and battery variants
Introducing the new Colossal and Mega variants for the Tanks and for the Batteries. 600% the capacity for 400% the size and it stacks exponentially(32x capacity for 16x size).
Blast Door
Who likes breaches? Doors make more sense.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/f16ccd75b4765fcbd17782d2411080320a8107cc.png


	Finish game event

Move aimlessly across the galaxy and eventually quit without any catharsis? Clear the central sector to mark your achievement into the game and into the leaderboard. Big notifications and a reward included.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/e543fe0e370bb71491bc1b563b7ed33a966fa032.png


	Atmosphere navigation

Get the necessary info to keep your ship on the correct trajectory with the new horizon and altitude indicators.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/5172105dd4d644165c5f5ab64a6ecf6546aaf648.gif


	New crafting & trading panel design

Because both needed an overhaul. New keybinds for stack crafting included.
With the new trading panel you can sell anything as long as it is an item and has some value.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/ffc1eb1fb3f7187f4c665445c0cb13306c0a97b6.png


	New 3d models & images for items

As with any update, I strive to bring a sense of consistent design across the entire game, thus adding 30 new models for items. And who doesn't like to both see the crensel cake and also eat it?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/4050b72209c29f95346ca62fb04c11bd6f62d148.png


	Deck editing with tools

I can't believe I didn't have this before, just right click and left click to edit the floor/roof of any adjacent deck. Perfect for making space for colossal tanks and panoramic views.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/f66e1b36f8d1ede4b63cbf97c85b771f98d66e7c.gif


	Popup crafting panel

Searching recursively for recipes is not fun. That's why now you can simply click on the missing ingredient and a popup with the available recipes for it will appear to quickly craft your pistol without having to switch crafting tabs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/9e72133bb838f1dbc36c051d2ad660801b8278ff.png


	Remote mission taking

Dock -> get mission -> undock takes to long. Just hail the station and the mission list will be downloaded on the electronics console for you to take. Convenient.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/55354599bf9ac1e7c0ca69fac7e287b4d16c1d11.png


	New Autopilot/ Nav. Assist options

Another QoL feature is the improved nav assist. With the new options to 
- automatically revert mid-way, 
- prevent overshooting,
- stop on proximity and 
- stop on collision 
you won't have to worry about the journey while you enjoy you crensel smoothie on the observation deck. What self driving level is that? 3?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/a368fd42342c4bf8e1280965464b24127c87bbe9.png


	New player & suit model for mp

Our avatar got a face lift!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/68336ed22c641d77fcfa79adcf13e88973b3effd.png


	Over 390 fixes/small qol features

Many smaller convenience features were added like:
- Suits drop when suitdocks are dismantled, same with hydroponics and seeds.
- More info on item description panel.
- Ammo is returned when weapon is sold/dismantled.
- Kick/ban/unban from pda.
- Detailed damage report directly on the driving hud.
- Start weapons and engines with one button each.
- Wave warning notifications.
- Detailed crew stats on the player list ui.
- Removing windows/cargo doors/airlocks no longer depressurizes the ship.
- Upgrading tanks/batteries doesn't lose their stored content.
And many more.





	Fire through shields

Finally you won't have to worry about getting hit because shields flicker to allow your projectiles. The new algorithms for shield emitters allows firing without having to turn the shields temporarily off. 




	Passive healing

Not having access to medical pods dooms you into a death loop. Just give it few minutes and your health will improve up to a point ... or more exactly, up to 50 points.




	Turret ammo unloading

Since you never use the gatling rounds because you can't land any hit why not sell them? 20K free at the start of the game? Sign me up!




	Hover mode for ships

Now this is a very convenient feature, gone are the days of throttling and having to manually remove the boosters to reduce as much as possible the vertical acceleration in atmosphere. Now you can even leave the ship inclined and it will eventually get to it's destination without crashing and without anyone driving (if you know how).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/77a0b4ac6dcc6a0a69b61254de669cee4a5f9ae8.gif


	Lots of balancing

A lot of recipes were changed, intermediate items removed and values tweaked in order to make the experience of playing as convenient as possible. New game loops were introduced like semiconductor crafting or turret recycling.




	Auto item equip

Look at a tank, hold F and automatically you will get the filled pouches from ship inventory and start pouring them one after another. Same for tools, heals, seeds, battery and reactor rods. One held key(F) to rule them all.




	2 times larger planets

Planet survival on a 32km planet? Nope, double it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/fac03c25abc38cddedb475ac2a4e02615e50381f.png


	Clientside projectiles

No longer get hit by invisible projectile because you live 500 milliseconds away. If you don't get hit from the projectiles that you can see, YOU DON'T GET HIT.



If you are interested in the full changelog, access it here: Full Changelog 0.10.5

Signing out,
Beholder

notes.title: Energy Update (v0.10.4)
notes.notes:
Hi captains!


This update is out, now!
You can play it yourself through the playtest option or through the demo. 

Those are the highlights:


	Electrolyzer, fuel cells, transformer

Ever run out of o2 and h2 but had mountains of unused water? Or are the turbines not providing enough power for you? I got you covered, convert liquids with each other and with both electricity grids like joggling balls. 
Electrolyzer: 2*h2o + electricity => h2 + 2*o2
Fuel cells: h2 + 2*o2 => 2*h2o + electricity
Transformer:  (Boost mode) Aux grid => Main grid, (Buck mode) Main grid => Aux grid

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/fd6dc78af2849066fd623e0bf3caebaf32d9e1a2.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/cc74f6e1b78545fc310fbe31c003567a3d58ec38.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/0537b122952b2e3ab4910eeae296bbcc7d5b1fe2.png

	Fusion & singularity reactors

Do you have nothing to sink your resources into in the end-game? Well, those 2 overpowered reactors will give you enough plasma to power a entire planet... sustainably.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/e27e427585e42e1970f6204fcc2f16d45cb0da70.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/8ce5b35edfda47ede00a7d567d905e677c5965a2.png

	New precise building system

No more overlaps and nice building animation. Did I mention you can place multiple blocks in the same voxel (1x1x1m) if they don't physically overlap? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/904ccfe653808956dc270c068f9a48949cd8ed52.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/ab5c6a4b32c58715e059fbfe05d45db7915cb1f7.gif

	RCS nozzle effects

No space sim is complete without RCS nozzle particles!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/018043fa266c754814a6e2d060c93d06cd81a7ea.gif

	New suitdock, lift, deck elevator and cargodoor

You will learn to love the deck elevator, up and down, get to other decks in no time, gone are the days of stairs or ladders.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/f1d162aeb98213b747d8f98fbd73ee376b54af8e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/5c672f240ec6bfe4f501e5b0ee9e85cdc214a47f.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/a3c03bdd56b41ed1d9724cdf417d598e9e49740c.png


	Updated energy console

Well... we can't have all those new energy blocks without a 80 button startup procedure, now can we?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/172a79ca12ab3871868c27a8c873a7a565602aad.png

	All blocks on inside

Getting out of the ship for repairs is not fun, I know; that's why all blocks are accessible for repairs from inside as well.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/e0c3d5ae2d7407183771261f0492fa88d4ea01d1.png

	Rename ship command

Somehow 'Crocked sparrow' sound way better than 'My Ship(7)'. Let's see what names you come up with. Remember, type in chat: /renameship [name of ship]  .

	Lots of multiplayer fixes

After hours and hours of playing multiplayer I never got a single error(desync/network errors not included). MP is getting more and more stable with each update.

	New items and item sprites

Plushies for me, plushies for you , plushies for everyone.
Ran out of power and only need seconds to start up the turbines? The hand held crank generator will give you the squeeze you need to run the energy console for a bit. 
Last but not least, you don't have to work so hard writing the complains about the bad quality item images, I know and I am actively updating them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/b91126d5e8fbc63fdfc33fc5a2f62134c86a92f7.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/021639f41af500a6aa55c21968d3d2eae7cff65c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/5331b9ac47c62735b502d7017dc3571e2a4467fc.png

	More modding options

Tired of the same red cone model you see when you shoot the gatlings? You can shoot rubber ducks at turrets now. Be the first one to make this mod! Oooor replace bullets with individually loadable ammo clips. Blocks, recipes and items got new configurable fields for you to play with.

	Dismantling gets all items back

Placed the RCS in the wrong orientation? Want to clear a hallway for your battery farm? I got you covered. Take apart any block and recraft it again at no additional cost.


Signing out,
Beholder

notes.title: Farming Update (v0.10.2)
notes.notes:
Hi captains!


This update is out, now!
You can play it yourself through the playtest option or through the demo. 

Those are the highlights:


	New farming system

It was about time! multi stage growing, water/compost requirements and planting fruits directly are some of the new options.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/efdbcf54559e6d7225c6b0bd0d44975cd724c4bd.png

	3 new consoles

Though still in prototype phase, they have all the functionalities of the legacy consoles. Proper layout will come in next updates. All about removing legacy blocks. Did I mention they are fully modable?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/5fd6e5a5f6c3db620094f953761db8b470c47872.png

	6 new crops

Namium, nurins, olis, crensel, artein and tiuras. You will learn to rely on them for subsistence since the traders won't sell you anything edible anymore, jerks. Did you know you can plant things other than seeds and crops? Find out what :).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/a314619ff2c836100bd7186ca252c45a93f96fc9.png

	New shield system and blocks

Remember when you used to press one button to completely recharge the shields? Now they recharge very slowly and only when deactivated but can be stacked to increase the shield capacity.
Because one is too few and 3 are to many.... for a normal ship, 9 tiers should be enough to make your ship a moving bullet black hole. They also look nice.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/385f1b7ec2b6a24cb4b33e559f7b9095c4d82428.png

	17 new food items

Each with it's own reference, can you name them all? You thought I would make a farming update without adding a use for the plants? Guess again.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/aab0cc3df42ea12907764e6be0271987e64f7bc0.png

	New models for 32 current blocks

In line with the aesthetics of Adro.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/a9be77d16d016bdfe43c4f5c5ed5d270b29ffba0.png

	Target tracking

For those that can't git gud. If you think the new shields are op wait until you see this. Need the mainframe to access this overpowered ship ability. All projectiles are way faster now so at close range all hits are guaranteed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/ecb70ee830552deab8724b91ca4f910bdb7a8d24.gif

	Feedback & news panels

For when you can't be bothered to join Discord, share with me your precious feedback and receive them precious news, directly from the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623196/55e74fc31e29392bc1ed5c6b26fb4061f3ad13c6.png

	Configurable brightness & light quality

All about supporting computers with lower specs, hey, not all simulated realities can afford to have more than one quality light source. 
For when your audience only sees black in your twitch streams, pump the brightness up to blinding to silence them.

	Hull breach fixing

No longer have to scrap that nanoscopic collider in the frame block, the new hull breaches require patch plates to fix and have a proper full area collider.

	Lots of fixes and tweaks

Removing unneeded steps/items/recipes, you know... making the gameplay less grindy. Made missions actually worth doing, added more navigation info, more recycling to prevent excess items and many other QoL modifications.

	Proper audio modding

Thanks to naudio (library) you can bring your own melodic creations into Adro. Variable bit rate, multi/single channel, yes we support them all.

	Auto port forwarding

Can't be bothered to connect to your router to do a port forward?, do these words sound like Chinese? I got you covered. By default Adro will let others connect to you over internet even if your network does not allow it, as long as your router knows the UPNP protocol.

	Dedicated server mode

Automation at its finest, script a server to start/stop from a shell/command prompt on a remote machine without human intervention. There are also special commands like ban, unban, kick, restart and all the usual management set.

	Lots of new modding options

Block light modding, farming modding, liquids/grids fill level modding and blocks particle effects modding, let your creative aberrations become alive in Adrorium.
